description: This file defines the event system for reasoner state changes, including event types, event struct, an event bus with subscribe/unsubscribe/publish mechanisms, and helper functions for common event types. It also includes a heartbeat mechanism to monitor active subscribers.

methods.name: NewReasonerEventBus
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of ReasonerEventBus

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Adds a new subscriber channel to the event bus for a given subscriber ID

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes a subscriber channel from the event bus and closes the channel

methods.name: Publish
methods.description: Broadcasts a ReasonerEvent to all current subscribers

methods.name: GetSubscriberCount
methods.description: Returns the number of active subscribers

methods.name: ToJSON
methods.description: Serializes a ReasonerEvent to its JSON string representation
